title: Business Dashboard
description: Orders/hr, revenue, cart conversion, payment success — is the business working?

panels.title: Orders per Hour
panels.description: New PENDING orders created. A sudden drop means the checkout flow is broken.

panels.title: Payment Success Rate (%)
panels.description: payment_success_rate_percent gauge — updated whenever Stripe webhooks arrive.

panels.title: Cart → Order Conversion Rate (%)
panels.description: cart_to_order_conversion_rate — how many carts result in a placed order.

panels.title: Inventory Reservation Failures/min
panels.description: Out-of-stock rejections at checkout. Spikes during flash sales are normal; sustained spikes indicate a bug.

panels.title: Order Status Breakdown
panels.description: Orders by lifecycle stage over time. CANCELLED spike alongside PENDING drop means payment is failing.

panels.title: Payment Events Over Time
panels.description: succeeded / failed / refunded. failed spike = Stripe issue. refunded spike = customer dissatisfaction.
